name: Sheath of Perfect Defense
body:
Price 4,354 GP Slot none; CL 5th; Weight 4 lbs.; Aura faint abjuration

DESCRIPTION

This +1 combat scabbard is treated as being wielded for the purpose of its effects when worn on a creature’s hip or back, and grants a +1 shield bonus whenever its wielder makes an iaijutsu slash as long as they have a free hand. This bonus stacks with that provided by the sheath block talent. If an attack would miss this weapon’s wielder by an amount equal to or less than the shield bonus provided by this weapon and the sheath block talent, the creature who made that attack takes a -1 circumstance penalty to their AC and CMD for 1 round, being knocked off balance. If the wielder has the master slash class feature, this penalty increases to -2. If the wielder has the divine slash class feature, this penalty increases to -3.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,177 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells shield
